topic: Flagship Project: Self-Hosted Kubernetes LLM Portfolio Concierge (kubernetes-llm-hosting-stack)
content: Brighton Kimani's flagship open-source repository is kubernetes-llm-hosting-stack (https://github.com/Gachagokimani/kubernetes-llm-hosting-stack) — a self-hosted Kubernetes AI Concierge engineered to run quantized GGUF LLMs (Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct via llama.cpp on CPU) on minimal RAM (under 4 GB) alongside hybrid RAG retrieval, SearXNG privacy-first web search, and persistent PVC storage.

topic: Other Open-Source GitHub Repositories: rhomes, Cybersmarter-business-system & firstlight-apartment
content: Beyond kubernetes-llm-hosting-stack, Brighton maintains three public repositories under https://github.com/Gachagokimani: (1) rhomes — a TypeScript scalable rental listings platform automating property discovery and tenant-landlord workflows; (2) Cybersmarter-business-system — a TypeScript end-to-end business management system for operational scaling, inventory control, and workflow automation; and (3) firstlight-apartment — a JavaScript residential rental showcase and unit inquiry web application.

Inside the ai-stack Kubernetes namespace, Brighton orchestrates specialized microservices: llama-server (C++ llama.cpp inference engine on NodePort 30880), SearXNG (meta-search engine on NodePort 30881), rag-frontend (Python FastAPI RAG orchestrator and portfolio UI on NodePort 30882), pdf-ingest-dotnet (.NET 8 Minimal API for PDF ingestion and Markdown cleanup), doc-indexer-spring (Java HTTP indexer for offer/proposal PDFs), and rbac-sso-dotnet (.NET 8 OAuth 2.0 SSO RBAC service).

topic: .NET 8 OAuth 2.0 SSO RBAC Microservice & Policy Decision Point
content: Brighton built a standalone .NET 8 RBAC and OAuth 2.0 SSO microservice (services/dotnet-rbac) deployable independently via k8s-deployment.yaml. It authenticates GitHub OAuth users against ADMIN_ALLOWED_IDS, mints HttpOnly HMAC-SHA256 JWT cookies (bk_sso_token), exposes a Policy Decision Point (/api/rbac/authorize), and strictly gates the Proposals navbar link, PDF upload bar, and private Proposals Vault.

topic: Kubernetes Secrets, ConfigMaps & etcd Encryption Hardening
content: In manifests/security/configmap-and-secret.yaml, Brighton centralized service endpoints into ai-stack-config (ConfigMap) and isolated OAuth client secrets, JWT signing keys, and PostgreSQL connection strings into ai-stack-secrets (Opaque Secret) backed by kube-apiserver EncryptionConfiguration (aescbc) for etcd encryption at rest.
